description: This file contains unit tests for the App component of a weather dashboard web application. It verifies that headers, input fields, and buttons are correctly rendered and functional, including user interactions such as input changes and button presence.

methods.name: test (renders weather dashboard header and search)
methods.description: Checks that the main header, location input, and search button are present and accessible.

methods.name: test (renders detect my location control)
methods.description: Verifies that the 'Detect my location' button is present.

methods.name: test (allows searching for a city)
methods.description: Simulates user input to the location field and verifies the value updates accordingly.
